Synthetic fixture: categorise incoming service requests.
The intake team categorises each incoming service request every working day using documented routing rules; the work is repeated and predictable.
The documented task is suitable for AI classification of request categories, while a conventional rules-only solution is not sufficient for the varied request text.
The organisation assigns high business value to accurate routing, requires human judgement for exceptions, retains human accountability, and assesses consequence as low with human oversight.
The organisation records moderate implementation complexity. The original process document does not state whether usable operational data is available for this activity.
